scope: S1445 and S2040 user-requested population-layout simplification

source_decisions.S1445: Use one direct Total cohort. The former 12 rows represented three maturity periods crossed with three growth-rate strata plus their maturity-period parents; they are intentionally not active population rows.
source_decisions.S2040: Use All players / PRO / U17 / U19. Preserve direct sample and age rows. Do not derive group-level rates or recovery summaries from genotype-specific Table 3 values.
